ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 75% of visible surface area is high-intensity (white/light grey) while 25% is low-intensity (black/dark grey) concentrated at the trailing edges and specific interior marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous zone centered on both lobes. Dark perimeter banding along the trailing edges. Right lobe features a distinctive 'AC'-shaped dark pixel cluster in the upper distal quadrant. Left lobe contains smaller, vertically-oriented dark streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations. Notable deep v-shaped notch on the right lobe trailing edge. Irregular pixel-peaks visible along the entire boundary between the fluke and water/sky background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe shows a convex sweep tapering to an acute point at the tip. Left lobe sweep is partially obscured by water splash but appears convex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity (white) circular pixel clusters are densely packed along the leading edges and fluke tips, exhibiting high contrast against the dark skin in those regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several low-intensity (dark) linear streaks are present on the white ventral surface of the right lobe, roughly parallel to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization (high-intensity circular clusters) on leading edges and tips. Large dark pigmentation mark on the distal portion of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The presence of a dark pattern resembling the characters 'AC' on the right lobe is a highly unique identifier.
